name: Light gate: her light and your lantern each hold a door
body: The pillar was too thin, so her light lit the crystal from almost anywhere. A wide shade wall and a smaller range make lit and dark ground clear; a second crystal beyond the door is held lit by the player's lantern so she can follow.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).

acceptance_criteria: The crystal is dark from the shaded side
She stands in the lit spot until you light the second crystal
